name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set, and that fallback is baked into password reset, rollup, and export emails. If the production deployment doesn't have `PUBLIC_URL` configured (e.g. after last week's release changed env handling), reset links silently point at localhost for every user. The fix should ensure a correct public base URL is always used in production, either by failing fast when `PUBLIC_URL` is missing in production or by fixing the deployment config to set it.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this value is used to build the password reset link (and other links in this file). If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, reset emails end up pointing at localhost, which matches the reported bug.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production deployment/config, and/or make the fallback fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error) instead of silently defaulting to localhost when running outside development, so misconfiguration is caught before emails go out with broken links.
